content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the alytaus district court the defendant has been ordered to pay various fees and compensation to the applicant the court has decided to divide the matrimonial property including a plot of land and a dwelling house equally between the parties the applicant will receive a vehicle as compensation and the defendant is responsible for paying off personal debts the court considered the defendants alcohol abuse and its impact on the family the court has allowed the dissolution of the marriage and ordered the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings the court has also declared that the defendant has personal debts to various creditors that need to be paid

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.89 Personal property of the spouses
